/-- **The zero set of a function of multiplicity one is a hypersurface**: regular of dimension
`n - 1` at each of its points in `U`. -/
theorem regularAtDim_zeroSet {U : Set X} (hU : IsOpen U) {u : X → ℂ}
    (hu : ∀ x ∈ U, HolomorphicAt n u x)
    (hu1 : ∀ x ∈ U, u x = 0 → ∃ (e : ComplexChart n X) (v : ComplexModel n),
      x ∈ e.val.source ∧ chartDeriv e v u x ≠ 0)
    {x : X} (hx : x ∈ U) (hux : u x = 0) :
    RegularAtDim (n := n) ({y | u y = 0} ∩ U) x (n - 1) := by
  obtain ⟨e, v, hxe, hd⟩ := hu1 x hx hux
  obtain ⟨hn, W, hWs, hWinj, hWu⟩ := exists_hypersurface_coords (hu x hx) hxe hd
  have hO : IsOpen (U ∩ (chartAt (ComplexModel n) x).source) :=
    hU.inter (chartAt (ComplexModel n) x).open_source
  have hxO : x ∈ U ∩ (chartAt (ComplexModel n) x).source := ⟨hx, mem_chart_source _ x⟩
  have hplane : ∀ y, W y ∈ complexCoordinatePlane n (n - 1) ↔ u y = 0 := fun y => by
    rw [mem_plane_pred_iff hn, hWu]
  obtain ⟨Θ, hΘt, hΘ0, hΘ⟩ :=
    exists_recentred_coords hO (fun z' hz' => hWs z' hz'.2 (hu z' hz'.1)) hxO hWinj
  refine ⟨Nat.sub_le n 1, ⟨hux, hx⟩, Θ, hΘt, hΘ0, fun {y} hy hyΘ => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨hyO, hΘy⟩ := hΘ hy hyΘ
  rw [hΘy, sub_mem_plane_iff ((hplane x).mpr hux), hplane]
  exact ⟨fun h => h.1, fun h => ⟨h, hyO.1⟩⟩

/-- **The maximum drops along canonical segments**: let the step along `C` follow a canonical segment `T`, `C` the maximum
locus of `inv T` on the cosupport, and `x₀ ∈ C`.  Along every canonical segment extending this step, every value on the
cosupport is smaller than the value of `x₀`, the maximum at `T`. -/
theorem lt_of_isCanonical_append {𝔪 : MarkedIdeal n X} {inv : ∀ {Y : CMfd.{u} n}, BlowupTower X Y → Y → Λ}
    (hdrop : StepDrop 𝔪 inv) {Y Z : CMfd.{u} n} (T : BlowupTower X Y) (C : Set Y) (π : Z → Y) (hπ : IsBlowupAlong n C π)
    (hC : C = maxLocus (inv T) (geoTransformAlong 𝔪 T).cosupp) {x₀ : Y} (hx₀ : x₀ ∈ C) :
    ∀ {W : CMfd.{u} n} (S : BlowupTower Z W), IsCanonical 𝔪 inv ((BlowupTower.step T C π hπ).append S) →
      ∀ z ∈ (geoTransformAlong 𝔪 ((BlowupTower.step T C π hπ).append S)).cosupp,
        inv ((BlowupTower.step T C π hπ).append S) z < inv T x₀
  | _, .refl, hcan, z, hz => by
      obtain ⟨hpz, h1, h2⟩ := hdrop T C π hπ hcan z hz
      subst hC
      exact lt_of_mem_maxLocus hx₀ hpz ⟨h1, h2⟩
  | _, .step S C' π' hπ', hcan, z, hz => by
      obtain ⟨hpz, h1, h2⟩ := hdrop _ C' π' hπ' hcan z hz
      have ih := lt_of_isCanonical_append hdrop T C π hπ hC hx₀ S hcan.1 (π' z) hpz
      by_cases hz' : π' z ∈ C'
      · exact (h1 hz').trans ih
      · exact (h2 hz').trans_lt ih

/-- **The one-step drop** (the hypothesis `hdec` of `ResolutionDriver.exists_isGeoResolution_of_wellFounded_invariant`):
blowing up the maximum locus after a canonical segment, every value on the new cosupport is smaller than the maximum. -/
theorem lt_of_isCanonical_step {𝔪 : MarkedIdeal n X} {inv : ∀ {Y : CMfd.{u} n}, BlowupTower X Y → Y → Λ}
    (hdrop : StepDrop 𝔪 inv) {Y Z : CMfd.{u} n} (T : BlowupTower X Y) (hT : IsCanonical 𝔪 inv T)
    {x₀ : Y} (hx₀ : x₀ ∈ maxLocus (inv T) (geoTransformAlong 𝔪 T).cosupp) (π : Z → Y)
    (hπ : IsBlowupAlong n (maxLocus (inv T) (geoTransformAlong 𝔪 T).cosupp) π) :
    ∀ z ∈ (geoTransformAlong 𝔪 (BlowupTower.step T (maxLocus (inv T) (geoTransformAlong 𝔪 T).cosupp) π hπ)).cosupp,
      inv (BlowupTower.step T (maxLocus (inv T) (geoTransformAlong 𝔪 T).cosupp) π hπ) z < inv T x₀ :=
  lt_of_isCanonical_append hdrop T _ π hπ rfl hx₀ BlowupTower.refl
    (⟨hT, Or.inr rfl⟩ : IsCanonical 𝔪 inv T ∧ (maxLocus (inv T) (geoTransformAlong 𝔪 T).cosupp = ∅ ∨
      maxLocus (inv T) (geoTransformAlong 𝔪 T).cosupp = maxLocus (inv T) (geoTransformAlong 𝔪 T).cosupp))

/-- **The ambient restricted comparison is an inclusion of ideals on the submanifold.**  Each
germ of `𝔞` at a point of `W` agrees on `W` with `∑ cᵢ tᵢ`, `tᵢ ∈ 𝔟`; restricting the identity
to `↥W` exhibits it as a combination of germs of `Res_W 𝔟`, and `IsInSpanAt.trans` propagates
this from the generators to an arbitrary germ of `Res_W 𝔞`. -/
theorem restrictIdeal_le_of_restrictLe {𝔞 𝔟 : GermIdeal n X} (h𝔞 : 𝔞.IsCoherent)
    (hle : RestrictLe W 𝔞 𝔟) :
    (restrictIdeal (k := k) (W := W) 𝔞).Le (restrictIdeal (k := k) (W := W) 𝔟) := by
  intro p G hG
  have hG' : IsInSpanAt (n := k)
      (fun s => ∃ a, 𝔞.mem p.1 a ∧ s = a ∘ (Subtype.val : W → X)) p G := hG
  show IsInSpanAt (n := k)
    (fun s => ∃ b, 𝔟.mem p.1 b ∧ s = b ∘ (Subtype.val : W → X)) p G
  refine IsInSpanAt.trans ?_ hG'
  rintro s ⟨a, hamem, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨N, t, c, ht, hc, heq⟩ := hle p.1 p.2 a hamem
  refine ⟨holomorphicAt_comp_val hval (holomorphicAt_of_mem_of_isCoherent h𝔞 hamem),
    N, fun i => fun q : W => t i q.1, fun i => fun q : W => c i q.1,
    fun i => ⟨t i, ht i, rfl⟩,
    fun i => holomorphicAt_comp_val hval (hc i), ?_⟩
  have hev := (continuous_subtype_val.continuousAt (x := p)).eventually
    (p := fun y => y ∈ W → a y = ∑ i, c i y * t i y) heq
  filter_upwards [hev] with q hq
  exact hq q.2

/-- **The maximum locus over `U`**: for a canonical segment `T` of `(X, X, ∅, 𝓘_V, 1)` whose centres miss the preimages of
`U = X ∖ V_sing`, once the maximum locus meets the preimage of `U` it contains, over `U`, exactly the preimage of `V`
(`EmbeddingFields.inv_eq_over_open_of_isEmptyTower_of_pureDim`: `V ∩ U = V_reg` is a closed submanifold of `U` of pure
dimension `dim V`). -/
theorem mem_maxLocus_iff_of_centresAvoid (hF : EmbeddingFields n k inv) (V : ClosedIrreducibleAnalyticSubvariety n X)
    (hdom : IsInvDomain k (⟨univ, [], vanishingIdeal (n := n) V.carrier, 1⟩ : MarkedIdeal n X))
    {Y : CMfd.{u} n} (T : BlowupTower X Y)
    (hcan : IsCanonical (⟨univ, [], vanishingIdeal (n := n) V.carrier, 1⟩ : MarkedIdeal n X)
      (inv (⟨univ, [], vanishingIdeal (n := n) V.carrier, 1⟩ : MarkedIdeal n X)) T)
    (hT : CentresAvoid (regularOpen V) T) {c : Y}
    (hc : c ∈ ResolutionDriver.maxLocus (inv (⟨univ, [], vanishingIdeal (n := n) V.carrier, 1⟩ : MarkedIdeal n X) T)
      (geoTransformAlong (⟨univ, [], vanishingIdeal (n := n) V.carrier, 1⟩ : MarkedIdeal n X) T).cosupp)
    (hcU : T.proj c ∈ regularOpen V) {y : Y} (hy : T.proj y ∈ regularOpen V) :
    y ∈ ResolutionDriver.maxLocus (inv (⟨univ, [], vanishingIdeal (n := n) V.carrier, 1⟩ : MarkedIdeal n X) T)
        (geoTransformAlong (⟨univ, [], vanishingIdeal (n := n) V.carrier, 1⟩ : MarkedIdeal n X) T).cosupp ↔
      T.proj y ∈ V.carrier := by

  have hcos := mem_cosupp_iff_of_centresAvoid V.isClosed_carrier hdom (regularOpen V) T hTt hT hy
  refine ⟨fun h => hcos.mp h.1, fun h => ?_⟩
  have hys := hcos.mpr h
  have hpure : ∀ x ∈ (Subtype.val : regularOpen V → X) ⁻¹' V.carrier,
      RegularAtDim (n := n) ((Subtype.val : regularOpen V → X) ⁻¹' V.carrier) x V.dim := fun x hx =>
    AnalyticSubsetOpens.regularAtDim_preimage_val_iff.mpr (regularAtDim_of_mem_regularOpen hx x.2)
  have hZ : IsClosedSubmanifold n ((Subtype.val : regularOpen V → X) ⁻¹' V.carrier) :=
    ⟨V.isClosed_carrier.preimage continuous_subtype_val, fun x hx => ⟨V.dim, hpure x hx⟩⟩
  have heq := hF.inv_eq_over_open_of_isEmptyTower_of_pureDim hdom (regularOpen V) hZ hpure T hcan
    ((isEmptyTower_restrict_iff (regularOpen V) T).mpr hT) (p := ⟨c, hcU⟩) (p' := ⟨y, hy⟩) hc.1 hys

  rw [show inv (⟨univ, [], vanishingIdeal (n := n) V.carrier, 1⟩ : MarkedIdeal n X) T y =
      inv (⟨univ, [], vanishingIdeal (n := n) V.carrier, 1⟩ : MarkedIdeal n X) T c from heq]

/-- **A blowup of a compact manifold is surjective**: it is an isomorphism over the
dense complement of the centre, and its image is compact, hence closed. -/
theorem surjective_of_isBlowupAlong [CompactSpace Y] {C : Set Y} {g : Z → Y}
    (hg : IsBlowupAlong n C g) : Function.Surjective g := by
  have := BlowupCompact.compactSpace_of_isBlowupAlong hg
  have hclosed : IsClosed (range g) := (isCompact_range hg.contMDiff.continuous).isClosed
  have hsub : Cᶜ ⊆ range g := fun y hy => by
    obtain ⟨z, -, hz⟩ :=
      (BlowupIsomorphismOff.isIsomorphismOver_compl_of_isBlowupAlong hg).1.2.2 hy
    exact ⟨z, hz⟩
  have hdense : closure Cᶜ = univ := by rw [closure_compl, hg.2.1, compl_empty]
  intro y
  have h := hclosed.closure_subset_iff.mpr hsub
  rw [hdense] at h
  exact h (mem_univ y)

/-- **A blowup sequence of a compact manifold** has compact source and is surjective. -/
theorem IsBlowupSequence.compactSpace_surjective [CompactSpace X] {f : Y → X}
    (hf : IsBlowupSequence n X Y f) : CompactSpace Y ∧ Function.Surjective f := by
  induction hf with
  | refl => exact ⟨inferInstance, Function.surjective_id⟩
  | step f C g _hf hg ih =>
      obtain ⟨hcompact, hsurj⟩ := ih
      have := hcompact
      exact ⟨BlowupCompact.compactSpace_of_isBlowupAlong hg,
        hsurj.comp (surjective_of_isBlowupAlong hg)⟩
